description: Expected schema for healthcare claims data.

fields.name: member_id
fields.description: Identifier of the member associated with the claim.

fields.name: service_date
fields.description: Date on which the healthcare service was provided.

fields.name: submission_date
fields.description: Date on which the claim was submitted.

fields.name: adjudication_date
fields.description: Date on which the claim was adjudicated, when applicable.

fields.name: claim_status
fields.description: Current processing status of the claim.

fields.name: cpt_hcpcs_code
fields.description: Procedure or service code when applicable.

fields.name: place_of_service
fields.description: Place where the healthcare service was provided.

fields.name: allowed_amount
fields.description: Amount allowed according to the applicable policy or contract.
